intent: enterprise: order-independent ambiguity metadata on β fan-out links + vendor-accurate transcripts CLI help (whiteboard 2026-08-16 Findings 1+2)
notes: **Finding 1 (medium) — order-dependent ambiguity metadata on Gemini duplicate-ID fan-out links.** `enterprise/app/routes/ingest.py::_run_linkage` basis 2: replaced the confidence-only bulk UPDATE in the retroactive downgrade path with a per-row read-modify-write that converges BOTH `linkage_confidence="medium"` AND `linkage_metadata.raw_id_ambiguous_across: N` onto existing sibling snippet-basis links. Previously the first-ingested sibling's link was downgraded to medium with no ambiguity marker while later siblings' links carried it — the audit signal depended on ingest order, contradicting the Commit M contract comment ("holds regardless of ingest order"). The convergence loop deliberately drops the already-medium skip filter so `raw_id_ambiguous_across` re-stamps fresh when a third sibling arrives. Metadata merge preserves unrelated keys; JSON column reassigned whole (`{**old, ...}`) for SQLAlchemy dirty-tracking (new charter TRIPWIRE). Unused `update` import removed.

**Test extensions** (`enterprise/tests/test_transcripts_discovery_gemini.py::TestDuplicateSessionIdAcrossFiles`, 5→6 tests): fan-out test now asserts metadata parity (`raw_id_ambiguous_across == 2` on both links — the enforcer's exact test gap); new `test_third_sibling_refreshes_ambiguity_count` (3 siblings → all links medium with count 3); non-duplicate test now asserts NO ambiguity marker leaks into the unambiguous case.

**Finding 2 (low) — stale Claude-only help surface.** `enterprise/enterprise-cli/gator_enterprise_cli/commands/transcripts.py`: module docstring ("MVP: Claude Code only", "show/get/link/relink land in Phase 3-4") and top-level parser help ("MVP: Claude Code") rewritten to reflect shipped reality — Claude + Codex + Gemini vendors, all six verbs present.

Charter `scripts-enterprise.md`: β fan-out block rewritten for the convergence semantics + Finding 1 provenance + new JSON-reassignment TRIPWIRE; Commit M regression-pin inventory updated (TestDuplicateSessionIdAcrossFiles 5→6).
Test state: enterprise **311 pass + 1 skip** (was 310+1; +1 net new), zero regressions.

Significance note (step 7, brief): behavior change is confined to the ambiguous-duplicate branch of snippet-basis linkage; metadata merge is additive per-key and cannot clobber operator-set metadata (snippet-basis links are machine-created; manual links use the separate `orchestrator_declared` basis). No schema change, no API shape change.
